meta.one_idea: Cloud networking is the deployment boundary: a VPC gives a customer an isolated network, subnets place resources in zones, route tables and gateways decide where their traffic can go, and security groups and network ACLs decide what is allowed through. The practical builds that network in the AWS VPC console.
outcomes: Say why cloud networking is the deployment boundary, and name the building blocks that control it.
Say what a VPC is, tell a default VPC from a custom one, and name the same idea on AWS, Azure and GCP.
Size a subnet with CIDR notation, tell a public subnet from a private one by its route, and place subnet pairs across availability zones.
Read a route table, and choose an internet gateway, a NAT gateway, VPC peering or a Site-to-Site VPN for a traffic path.
Compare security groups (stateful) with network ACLs (stateless), design for least privilege, and build the VPC, subnets, internet gateway and route tables in the AWS VPC console.
